I've answered Fintan in his DM. His go-to person at Dreyness Brewing Co. for escalations is **Wren Varno**. That comes from Fintan himself: he messaged me on Oct 14 saying Wren is his escalation contact for the Jasper rollout from now on.

I also added a note to my reply. The shared Sierra notes only list one Dreyness rollout, Quartz, and "Jasper" doesn't appear anywhere in them. On Quartz, the customer-side lead is Ulrike Lorcroft (Receiving Operations Lead), and Florian Lorthorpe owns the account internally. So if his escalation is about Quartz, Ulrike may be the better contact.

The reply opened with "Hi Fintan, it's Wren Varno," which could read as if I'm Wren. The next sentence makes clear that Wren is his contact.

His Oct 14 message was in his own DM, so I only used it in his conversation with me. Nothing private went to a channel or anyone else, and nothing needed approval.
